items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: I'm doing a very poor thing describing what Tatum could do. No one could describe just how these things happened with this man... To watch Tatum, the way he...

ctx.x: Oh, I didn't know Bernard Addison worked with Art Tatum.
Oh yeah, in Toledo, Ohio. They did "The Toledo Shout," and they released(?) it. He came up with Art Tatum.
Oh, I didn't know that. But one thing you said was that Red McKenzie sang with the Spirits of Rhythm at the Onyx.
